cases.context_or_mutation: Default canonical mode; exactly four TARGET plans in compile/resolve/replay/audit order, normal fixture/resolver prerequisite
cases.expected: Existing four children and fixture requirement preserved

cases.context_or_mutation: Omit module from any canonical plan before factory call
cases.expected: Reject at factory shape validation before context side effects/native launch

cases.context_or_mutation: Change a canonical module to any other module, including an allowed admission module
cases.expected: Reject at factory shape validation; explicit default mode stays canonical

cases.context_or_mutation: Omit/alter/reorder any canonical stage
cases.expected: Reject at factory shape validation

cases.context_or_mutation: Pass a singleton in default canonical mode
cases.expected: Reject; singleton is not inferred to be admission

cases.context_or_mutation: Mutate/remove module after factory returns but before class instantiation
cases.expected: Reject against serialized closure snapshot before context journal/scaffold writes

cases.context_or_mutation: Change/remove canonical module on p and self.plans entry that alias the same mutable object
cases.expected: Reject against independent frozen snapshot in before_child before launch

cases.context_or_mutation: Change/remove module in a later plan while beginning an earlier child
cases.expected: Reject full list snapshot comparison before the current launch

cases.context_or_mutation: Mutate stage on both live plan objects
cases.expected: Reject snapshot identity; cannot change fixture gate selection

cases.context_or_mutation: Mutate a nested argv/env/cwd/source-binding field through an alias
cases.expected: Reject recursive serialized snapshot comparison

cases.context_or_mutation: Replace self.plans with altered/cloned mutable entries
cases.expected: Reject against immutable closure authority

cases.context_or_mutation: Mutate canonical module between before_child and prepare_child
cases.expected: Reject repeated snapshot comparison before native launch

cases.context_or_mutation: Mutate canonical module between prepare_child and preexec
cases.expected: Reject repeated snapshot comparison before native exec authorization

cases.context_or_mutation: Alter/remove resolve module before after_child despite valid marker text
cases.expected: Reject snapshot; fixture observation selected from canonical closure/expected stage, not mutable module

cases.context_or_mutation: Alter/remove replay or audit module to try to avoid missing/failed/historical/unbound prerequisite
cases.expected: Reject snapshot before fixture check/native launch; late verifier also remains

cases.context_or_mutation: Explicit independently captured first CONTRACT replay_order module; one replay plan
cases.expected: Existing admission-only guards unchanged; no canonical fixture prerequisite

cases.context_or_mutation: Explicit independently captured second CONTRACT replay_order module; one replay plan
cases.expected: Existing admission-only guards unchanged; no canonical fixture prerequisite

cases.context_or_mutation: Explicit independently captured third CONTRACT replay_order module; one replay plan
cases.expected: Existing admission-only guards unchanged; no canonical fixture prerequisite

cases.context_or_mutation: Explicit admission_module is TARGET or outside CONTRACT replay_order
cases.expected: Reject constructor authority

cases.context_or_mutation: Alter a live admission plan module while its independent captured contract module is unchanged
cases.expected: Reject shape at construction or frozen snapshot at preflight

cases.context_or_mutation: Supply admit callback an entry not identical to any captured admission entry
cases.expected: Reject before building/launching its context

cases.context_or_mutation: Attempt changed/missing canonical module with real TARGET argv after any live failure
cases.expected: Existing late generic verifier/current-identity/prerequisite checks remain byte-identical; no substitution for live guard

cases.context_or_mutation: Explicit admission authority but checker argv has extra tokens/wrong checker or another target such as canonical TARGET
cases.expected: Reject constructor shape; the singleton command must be exactly checker,-v,independently authorized admission module
